parameters.name: tokenID
parameters.description: ID of the API token, from the list of every token

200.description: true when the token was revoked

400.description: The token id in the path is not a positive integer

403.description: Not allowed: the request was made with an API token, or the user is not an administrator

description:
Deletes a token of any user. It stops working at once and the revocation is in the audit log. Administrators cannot create or edit tokens for others.

Needs: a signed-in session of an administrator (API tokens are refused)
